table.evidence: try 1: selection "the"; popover true; focus after Cmd+K input[run.link.href]; field value "https://example.com/acme"; stored "https://example.com/acmeSee the proposal online" (word wrapped as a link false; URL leaked into the text true) | try 2: selection "the"; popover true; focus after Cmd+K input[run.link.href]; field value "https://example.com/acme"; stored "https://example.com/acmehttps://example.com/acmeSee the proposal online" (word wrapped as a link false; URL leaked into the text true) | try 3: selection "acmeSee"; popover true; focus after Cmd+K input[run.link.href]; field value "https://example.com/acme"; stored "https://example.com/acmehttps://example.com/acmehttps://example.com/acmeSee the proposal online" (word wrapped as a link false; URL leaked into the text true); screenshot docs/gslides-parity/focus/audit-text/83-link-clean.png
